name: Bonito Bonito AI Baby Dance: Your Baby Sips, Hugs and Sways to Un Cafecito Riquito
blurb: The Bonito Bonito trend is a TikTok baby dance to "Bonito, Bonito", the AI-made song with the hook "un cafecito riquito riquito".

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: kling-3-motion, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
One continuous single take, steady handheld camera, vertical video. Recreate the reference video exactly, but the dancer is the baby from the reference image instead of the woman: the same baby with the same face, hair, skin tone and clothes, standing upright in the place from the reference image.
The baby reproduces the woman's full dance frame by frame with the same timing, on the beat: the happy sway from side to side, one hand held flat under the chin with a proud smile, both hands lifting a small plain toy cup to the lips for a pretend sip, the arms swinging out, both arms hugging its own body tight, a hand held to the ear like a phone call, then the points and the bouncy sway, and at the very end both index fingers pointing at the camera. Above all her big, warm facial acting: wide smiles, raised brows and sweet looks into the camera, as if singing along. Very expressive, joyful baby face.
The baby keeps real baby anatomy: a small chubby body, a big round head, short arms and legs and small baby hands, never an adult body, no jewelry, even when it leans toward the lens. The cup is only a pretend toy cup, never a hot drink. No cuts, no text, no captions or labels on screen. No white blazer, no black T-shirt with a logo, no black skirt, no long straight auburn hair, no paper coffee cup with a logo, no rings and no painted nails unless the reference image shows them. Exactly one baby, no extra people.
